notes: Tape Deck now discovers Video on Demand and Tater Tube Server music automatically, combines both library lists when available, and removes the manual provider setting.
Game Center now indexes the main RetroNAS manufacturer/system layout once per refresh and preserves its completed catalog across boots, reconnects, and app updates.
Adds working Nintendo 64 support on Raspberry Pi 4 and Pi 5 with the pinned Mupen64Plus-Next ARM64 core.
Adds complete left- and right-stick RetroPad mappings, including right-stick N64 C-button control and safe migration of legacy controller maps.
Standardizes bundled game-port discovery on the RetroNAS ROM layout and improves the cached-library loading screen.
